page: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the Eadv6 server family. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz, this instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 2 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The hardware configuration includes 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Storage is bundled with a 236 GB local disk, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. No GPU resources are included. The virtualization layer is managed by Microsoft Hyper-V.

Benchmark data reveals strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. Multi-core performance is average, as shown by the stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core scores. However, memory bandwidth is a notable bottleneck; both small-block cached and large-block uncached read-only memory bandwidth tests scored in the bottom 25%. This limitation is reflected in database operations and Redis SET benchmarks, which also placed in the bottom 25%. For lightweight language model tasks, the server achieves average prompt processing and text generation speeds with a 135M model, but performance drops significantly to the bottom 10% for prompt processing with a larger 7B model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E4ads_v6 offers a dense memory allocation relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for memory-bound workloads that do not require high memory bandwidth or massive parallel processing. The inclusion of a 236 GB local disk provides immediate storage capacity without requiring external attachments. Given the strong single-core performance alongside weak memory bandwidth and multi-threaded decompression, this server is best suited for memory-optimized applications, lightweight web serving, and text processing tasks rather than high-throughput database engines or intensive software compilation.
description: Microsoft Azure E4ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the Eadv6 family, featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, it includes a 236 GB local disk and supports Premium Storage. Benchmarks indicate strong single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests. However, memory read bandwidth is a distinct bottleneck, scoring in the bottom 25% for both cached and uncached operations. This constraint impacts database operations and Redis SET performance, which also rank in the bottom 25%. Consequently, the E4ads_v6 is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-heavy workloads with moderate throughput requirements, such as text processing, static web serving, and lightweight application hosting, rather than high-performance database systems.
